Topics.Title: User and Team Analytics
Topics.Summary: Review clear activity totals, trends, and recent history without the old score model.
Topics.Content:
User and Team Analytics

The analytics workspace shows clear activity data for the selected date range. It replaces the old scoring view with simple, explainable metrics.

Summary Cards

  • Total Transactions: Every recorded inventory movement inside the selected range.
  • Total Quantity Moved: The summed quantity across matching transactions.
  • Unique Parts Handled: Distinct part numbers touched during the range.
  • Active Days: Calendar days with at least one matching transaction.

Fairness Rules

Advanced Inventory and Advanced Remove are labeled for clarity, but they count the same as single actions in all totals and trends.

Role Behavior

  • Normal users see only their own analytics.
  • Admin and developer roles can review team totals and drill down into an individual user.

Using the Page

  1. Open View > Analytics or launch analytics from the Visual dashboard.
  2. Adjust the date range.
  3. Switch between Transactions and Quantity for the trend chart.
  4. Use the activity filter chips to narrow recent activity.
  5. Use Export Summary CSV, Export Activity CSV, or Print for reporting.

Topics.Title: Data Visualization
Topics.Summary: Understanding the trend and drill-down views.
Topics.Content:
Data Visualization

The analytics page uses a simple trend chart instead of a leaderboard or grading model.

Trend View

  • Daily / Weekly: Group activity by day or by week.
  • Transactions / Quantity: Switch the chart to compare movement count or total quantity.
  • Peak / Quiet Periods: The page highlights the busiest and quietest periods inside the selected range.

Team Drill-Down

When team access is available, select a user from the drill-down panel to view the same personal layout for that user without opening a separate window.

Topics.Title: Exporting and Printing
Topics.Summary: Export data to Excel or print reports.
Topics.Content:
Exporting and Printing

The analytics workspace includes export and print actions directly in the header.

Summary Export

  1. Click Export Summary CSV.
  2. In team scope, the export includes the visible user summary list.
  3. In personal scope, the export includes the current summary metrics.

Activity Export

  1. Click Export Activity CSV.
  2. The export reflects the current user drill-down and activity-type filter.

Print

  1. Click Print.
  2. The page switches to a letter-size print layout with summary cards, trend view, recent activity, and glossary content.

Note: Printed output uses the current filters on screen.
